title: KB Labs error envelope
description: One error contract shared by the Go launcher (LauncherError), the TS platform and Studio. See docs/architecture/target/08-errors.md section 2.

code.description: Stable, never reused. Platform codes are KB_<AREA>_<CONDITION>; product plugins use <PLUGIN>_<CONDITION>.

stage.description: Journey moment (02-ux-journey). Moment 2 install: preflight, resolve, apply, verify, recover. Moment 3 onboarding and sessions: start, login. Moment 4: add-project. Moments 5-6 daily work: run. Moment 7: extend. Moment 8: update, rollback. Moment 9 (failure) is not a stage; any error can occur in any stage.

cause.description: Why it happened. Never contains secrets.

hint.description: What to do now: a command or an action.

correlationId.description: Finds the record in the logs.
